title: CNMF (CaImAn)
description: Finds cells with CaImAn's CNMF (constrained non-negative matrix factorization: greedy initialisation, then spatial and temporal updates and merging), as dev's roimanager could. Its cells are saved as ROIs (the connected pixels around each footprint's peak whose weight is above threshold times the peak's), their traces (denoised calcium plus residual) as signals and the denoised calcium too. The stack is read whole. CaImAn in Python, CaImAn-MATLAB in MATLAB.

rois.title: ROIs
rois.description: Variable the cells are saved to as ROIs.

output.title: Signals
output.description: Each cell's denoised calcium plus residual (frames x cells). Leave empty to not save it.

denoisedOutput.title: Denoised calcium
denoisedOutput.description: Each cell's denoised calcium. Leave empty to not save it.

mergeThreshold.title: Merge threshold
mergeThreshold.description: Components whose traces correlate more than this are merged.

threshold.title: Mask threshold
threshold.description: Share of a cell's largest spatial weight a pixel needs to be part of its ROI

firstFrame.title: First frame
firstFrame.description: The first frame to process, from 1 (dev's frame interval): the method works on frames firstFrame..lastFrame only, and its outputs have that many frames.

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: The last frame to process; 0 for the last frame of the stack.
